request.query: cardinality finite Cartesian product equals product of cardinalities

items.name: Set.encard_pi_eq_prod_encard
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [h : Fintype α] {ι : α → Type u_3} {s : (i : α) → Set (ι i)},
  (Set.univ.pi s).encard = ∏ i, (s i).encard

items.name: Cardinal.mk_prod
items.type:
∀ (α : Type u) (β : Type v),
  Cardinal.mk (α × β) = Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk α) * Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Cardinal.mk β)

items.name: Finsupp.card_pi
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] (f : ι →₀ Finset α), f.pi.card = f.prod fun i => ↑(f i).card

items.name: Set.encard_prod
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Set α} {t : Set β}, (s ×ˢ t).encard = s.encard * t.encard

items.name: Set.ncard_prod
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Set α} {t : Set β}, (s ×ˢ t).ncard = s.ncard * t.ncard

items.name: Nat.card_pi
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_3} [inst : Fintype α], Nat.card ((a : α) → β a) = ∏ a, Nat.card (β a)

items.name: Cardinal.mk_setProd
items.type: ∀ {α β : Type u} (s : Set α) (t : Set β), Cardinal.mk ↑(s ×ˢ t) = Cardinal.mk ↑s * Cardinal.mk ↑t

items.name: Cardinal.mk_pi
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u} (α : ι → Type v), Cardinal.mk ((i : ι) → α i) = Cardinal.prod fun i => Cardinal.mk (α i)
